summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated 727KB payload via bootstrapped Bun
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, and setup.mjs (with obfuscator.io-style `_0x`-prefixed identifiers) downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a shipped sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(<bun>, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB single-line obfuscator.io-style blob at the package root (rotating string-array shift routine, hex-named globals, character-code table, alphabet decoder) that is not mentioned in README, CHANGELOG, or package.json. The declared package source (`src/index.ts`) is a two-line Hello-world module that exports the string `Hello ${name}!`. The alternate-runtime hop (Node preinstall bootstraps Bun, then Bun executes the opaque payload) is the classic pattern used to evade Node-focused review and run attacker-controlled bytes on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
